notes: Authors: reghdfe salescogs s_law, absorb(year s_id) vce(cluster s_incorp) if use==1 on finalSegmentSupplier.dta (supplier-year, 1992-2010, 21,704 rows, use==1 for all; 17 rows with missing salescogs dropped). Outcome = supplier sales/COGS minus 1 (gross margin). gvar g_law = state-level first treated year as coded (1998, 2002, 2003 [Delaware, 2,916 of 4,419 suppliers], 2005, 2006, 2007; NA for 43 never-adopting states); D = 1{year >= g_law} equals s_law on every row. 897 suppliers switch in sample, 670 enter already treated, 1,236 are in never-adopting states, 1,616 are in adopting states but observed only before the law. 1,218 suppliers have gaps in their year sequence (CSA uses composition-fixed cells). Clusters: 50 states; Delaware holds 14,222 of 21,704 rows, so the leverage screen is expected to fail. Pipeline keeps 859 singleton rows that reghdfe drops; point estimate unchanged.
